question_en: Which statements are true? 1) The work of an electrostatic field along a closed path is zero. 2) Equipotential surfaces can cross. 3) $\vec E$ points towards decreasing potential. 4) Inside a charged conductor $\varphi=0$.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) Elektrostatik maydonning berk yo'ldagi ishi nolga teng. 2) Ekvipotensial sirtlar kesishishi mumkin. 3) $\vec E$ potensial kamayadigan tomonga yo'nalgan. 4) Zaryadlangan o'tkazgich ichida $\varphi=0$.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) Работа электростатического поля по замкнутому пути равна нулю. 2) Эквипотенциальные поверхности могут пересекаться. 3) $\vec E$ направлен в сторону убывания потенциала. 4) Внутри заряженного проводника $\varphi=0$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. 1 va 3 to'g'ri; ekvipotensial sirtlar kesishmaydi, o'tkazgich ichida E = 0, lekin φ = kq/R.
Asos: potensial maydon xossalari.

en: 1, 3 are true: $A=0$ on a closed path.
2 is false: $\varphi$ is unique at a point.

distractors_en.A: statement 4 is false: inside φ = kq/R
distractors_en.C: statement 2 is false: equipotentials never cross
distractors_en.E: statement 4 is false and statement 1 is true

question_en: The potential energy of a $2\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ charge at some point of a field is $0.9\ \mathrm{mJ}$. Find the potential of that point ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_uz: Maydonning biror nuqtasidagi $2\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ zaryadning potensial energiyasi $0.9\ \mathrm{mJ}$. Shu nuqta potensialini toping ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_ru: Потенциальная энергия заряда $2\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ в некоторой точке поля равна $0.9\ \mathrm{mJ}$. Найдите потенциал этой точки ($\mathrm{V}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. φ = W/q = 0.9·10⁻³/(2·10⁻⁶) = 450 V.
Asos: potensial ta'rifi.

distractors_ru.D: mJ и μC не переведены в СИ

distractors_en.A: the energy was multiplied by the charge
distractors_en.D: mJ and μC were not converted to SI
distractors_en.E: nC was used instead of μC

question_en: A $3\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ charge moves from a point at $250\ \mathrm{V}$ to a point at $50\ \mathrm{V}$. Find the work of the field ($\mathrm{mJ}$).
question_uz: $3\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ zaryad potensiali $250\ \mathrm{V}$ bo'lgan nuqtadan potensiali $50\ \mathrm{V}$ bo'lgan nuqtaga ko'chdi. Maydon ishini toping ($\mathrm{mJ}$).
question_ru: Заряд $3\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ переместился из точки с потенциалом $250\ \mathrm{V}$ в точку с потенциалом $50\ \mathrm{V}$. Найдите работу поля ($\mathrm{mJ}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. A = q(φ₁ − φ₂) = 3·10⁻⁶ · 200 = 6·10⁻⁴ J = 0.6 mJ.
Asos: maydon ishi va potensiallar farqi.

distractors_en.D: only the initial potential was used
distractors_en.E: only the final potential was used

question_en: At a distance $r$ from a point charge the potential is $240\ \mathrm{V}$. Find the potential at a distance $4r$ from the charge ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_uz: Nuqtaviy zaryaddan $r$ masofada potensial $240\ \mathrm{V}$. Zaryaddan $4r$ masofadagi potensialni toping ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_ru: На расстоянии $r$ от точечного заряда потенциал равен $240\ \mathrm{V}$. Найдите потенциал на расстоянии $4r$ от заряда ($\mathrm{V}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. φ ∼ 1/r: masofa 4 marta ortsa, potensial 4 marta kamayadi: 240/4 = 60 V.
Asos: φ = kq/r.

distractors_en.A: the potential was multiplied by the distance
distractors_en.B: 1/r² was used; that is for E
distractors_en.C: the distance was taken to double
distractors_en.E: φ does depend on the distance

question_en: An electron passes through a potential difference of $50\ \mathrm{V}$. By how many joules does its kinetic energy change? $e=1.6\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$.
question_uz: Elektron $50\ \mathrm{V}$ potensiallar farqini o'tdi. Uning kinetik energiyasi necha joulga o'zgardi? $e=1.6\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$.
question_ru: Электрон прошёл разность потенциалов $50\ \mathrm{V}$. На сколько джоулей изменилась его кинетическая энергия? $e=1.6\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. ΔW = eU = 50 eV = 50 · 1.6·10⁻¹⁹ = 8·10⁻¹⁸ J.
Asos: maydon ishi eU, elektronvolt.

distractors.A: bu eV da, J da emas

distractors_ru.A: это в eV, а не в J
distractors_ru.D: ошибка в степени: в 10 раз больше

distractors_en.A: this is in eV, not J
distractors_en.B: the charge was divided by the voltage

question_en: Charges of $+6\ \mathrm{nC}$ and $-6\ \mathrm{nC}$ are $10\ \mathrm{cm}$ apart. Find the potential at the midpoint between them ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_uz: $+6\ \mathrm{nC}$ va $-6\ \mathrm{nC}$ zaryadlar bir-biridan $10\ \mathrm{cm}$ masofada turibdi. Ularning o'rtasidagi nuqtada potensialni toping ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_ru: Заряды $+6\ \mathrm{nC}$ и $-6\ \mathrm{nC}$ находятся на расстоянии $10\ \mathrm{cm}$ друг от друга. Найдите потенциал в точке посередине между ними ($\mathrm{V}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Potensiallar algebraik qo'shiladi: +1080 V va −1080 V, yig'indi 0 (E esa nol emas).
Asos: potensial — skalyar.

distractors_en.A: the potential of one charge was taken
distractors_en.C: the magnitudes were added; the sign was ignored
distractors_en.D: the distance was taken as 10 cm
distractors_en.E: only the potential of the negative charge

question_en: An uncharged ball of radius $R$ is connected by a wire to a distant ball of radius $2R$ carrying charge $q$. What charge goes to the small ball?
question_uz: Radiusi $R$ bo'lgan zaryadsiz shar $q$ zaryadli, radiusi $2R$ bo'lgan uzoqdagi shar bilan sim orqali tutashtirildi. Kichik sharga qanday zaryad o'tadi?
question_ru: Незаряженный шар радиусом $R$ соединили проводом с удалённым шаром радиусом $2R$, имеющим заряд $q$. Какой заряд перейдёт на малый шар?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Potensiallar tenglashadi, zaryadlar radiuslarga proporsional: q·R/(R + 2R) = q/3.
Asos: tutashtirilgan sharlar.

distractors_ru.B: это заряд, оставшийся на большом шаре

distractors_en.A: the balls were taken as identical
distractors_en.B: this is the charge left on the large ball
distractors_en.D: not all the charge flows over
distractors_en.E: there is a potential difference, so charge flows

question_en: A metal ball of radius $5\ \mathrm{cm}$ carries a charge of $2\ \mathrm{nC}$. Find the potential $2\ \mathrm{cm}$ from the centre of the ball ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_uz: Radiusi $5\ \mathrm{cm}$ bo'lgan metall sharga $2\ \mathrm{nC}$ zaryad berilgan. Shar markazidan $2\ \mathrm{cm}$ masofadagi potensialni toping ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_ru: Металлическому шару радиусом $5\ \mathrm{cm}$ сообщили заряд $2\ \mathrm{nC}$. Найдите потенциал на расстоянии $2\ \mathrm{cm}$ от центра шара ($\mathrm{V}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Shar ichida potensial sirtdagidek: φ = kq/R = 9·10⁹ · 2·10⁻⁹/0.05 = 360 V.
Asos: o'tkazgich ichida φ = const.

en: $r<R$ — the potential equals the surface value: $$\varphi=k\frac{q}{R}=\frac{18}{0.05}=360\ \mathrm{V}$$

distractors.B: nuqtaviy zaryad formulasi shar ichida qo'llangan
distractors.C: ichkarida E = 0, lekin φ nol emas

distractors_ru.B: формула точечного заряда применена внутри шара
distractors_ru.C: внутри E = 0, но φ не равен нулю

distractors_en.B: the point-charge formula was used inside the ball
distractors_en.C: inside E = 0, but φ is not zero
distractors_en.D: the distance was taken as 2 cm from the surface
distractors_en.E: the distance was taken as 10 cm

question_en: The voltage between parallel plates $4\ \mathrm{mm}$ apart is $120\ \mathrm{V}$. Find the field strength ($\mathrm{V/m}$).
question_uz: Orasidagi masofa $4\ \mathrm{mm}$ bo'lgan parallel plastinkalar orasidagi kuchlanish $120\ \mathrm{V}$. Maydon kuchlanganligini toping ($\mathrm{V/m}$).
question_ru: Напряжение между параллельными пластинами, расстояние между которыми $4\ \mathrm{mm}$, равно $120\ \mathrm{V}$. Найдите напряжённость поля ($\mathrm{V/m}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. E = U/d = 120/0.004 = 3·10⁴ V/m.
Asos: bir jinsli maydonda E = U/d.

distractors_en.C: mm were not converted to metres

question_en: Charges of $+3\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ and $+5\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ are in vacuum $50\ \mathrm{cm}$ apart. Find their interaction energy ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_uz: $+3\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ va $+5\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ zaryadlar vakuumda bir-biridan $50\ \mathrm{cm}$ masofada turibdi. Ularning o'zaro ta'sir energiyasini toping ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_ru: Заряды $+3\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ и $+5\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ находятся в вакууме на расстоянии $50\ \mathrm{cm}$ друг от друга. Найдите энергию их взаимодействия ($\mathrm{J}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. W = kq₁q₂/r = 9·10⁹ · 15·10⁻¹²/0.5 = 0.27 J; bir xil ishorali zaryadlarda W > 0.
Asos: o'zaro ta'sir energiyasi.

distractors.A: r² ga bo'lingan — bu kuch formulasi
distractors.C: ishora noto'g'ri: zaryadlar bir xil ishorali

distractors_ru.A: разделено на r² — это формула силы

distractors_en.A: divided by r²; that is the force formula
distractors_en.C: wrong sign: the charges are alike

question_en: $8$ identical charged spherical drops, each at $10\ \mathrm{V}$, merge into one drop. Find its potential ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_uz: Har birining potensiali $10\ \mathrm{V}$ bo'lgan $8$ ta bir xil zaryadlangan sharsimon tomchi qo'shilib, bitta tomchi hosil qildi. Uning potensialini toping ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_ru: $8$ одинаковых заряженных сферических капель с потенциалом $10\ \mathrm{V}$ каждая слились в одну каплю. Найдите её потенциал ($\mathrm{V}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Zaryad 8 marta, radius ∛8 = 2 marta ortadi: φ = 8/2 · 10 = 40 V.
Asos: φ = kq/R, hajm saqlanadi.

distractors_en.C: only the radius growth was used

question_en: Points $A$ and $B$ on one field line of a uniform field have potentials $\varphi_A=80\ \mathrm{V}$ and $\varphi_B=-40\ \mathrm{V}$, with $AB=6\ \mathrm{cm}$. Find the field strength ($\mathrm{V/m}$).
question_uz: Bir jinsli maydonning bitta kuch chizig'ida yotgan $A$ va $B$ nuqtalar potensiallari $\varphi_A=80\ \mathrm{V}$, $\varphi_B=-40\ \mathrm{V}$, $AB=6\ \mathrm{cm}$. Maydon kuchlanganligini toping ($\mathrm{V/m}$).
question_ru: Потенциалы точек $A$ и $B$, лежащих на одной силовой линии однородного поля, $\varphi_A=80\ \mathrm{V}$, $\varphi_B=-40\ \mathrm{V}$, $AB=6\ \mathrm{cm}$. Найдите напряжённость поля ($\mathrm{V/m}$).

distractors_en.A: cm were not converted to metres

question_en: An electron at rest is accelerated through $45.5\ \mathrm{V}$. Find its speed ($\mathrm{m/s}$). $e=1.6\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$, $m=9.1\cdot10^{-31}\ \mathrm{kg}$.
question_uz: Tinch turgan elektron $45.5\ \mathrm{V}$ kuchlanishda tezlatildi. Uning tezligini toping ($\mathrm{m/s}$). $e=1.6\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$, $m=9.1\cdot10^{-31}\ \mathrm{kg}$.
question_ru: Покоившийся электрон ускорили напряжением $45.5\ \mathrm{V}$. Найдите его скорость ($\mathrm{m/s}$). $e=1.6\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$, $m=9.1\cdot10^{-31}\ \mathrm{kg}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. eU = mv²/2: v = √(2eU/m) = √(1.6·10¹³) = 4·10⁶ m/s.
Asos: energiyaning saqlanishi.

distractors_en.B: the square root was not taken; this is v²
distractors_en.D: the mass was used in grams

question_en: The figure shows the equipotential surfaces of the field of a point charge and their potentials. Find the work done by the field when a $2\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ charge moves from point $K$ to point $M$ ($\mu\mathrm{J}$).
question_uz: Rasmda nuqtaviy zaryad maydonining ekvipotensial sirtlari va ularning potensiallari ko'rsatilgan. $2\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ zaryadni $K$ nuqtadan $M$ nuqtaga ko'chirishda maydon bajargan ishni toping ($\mu\mathrm{J}$).
question_ru: На рисунке показаны эквипотенциальные поверхности поля точечного заряда и их потенциалы. Найдите работу поля при перемещении заряда $2\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ из точки $K$ в точку $M$ ($\mu\mathrm{J}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. K da φ = 40 V, M da φ = 10 V: A = q(φK − φM) = 2·10⁻⁶ · 30 = 60 μJ; yo'l shakli ahamiyatsiz.
Asos: A = q(φ₁ − φ₂).

distractors.B: K va M bitta sirtda emas

distractors_ru.B: K и M не на одной поверхности

distractors_en.A: only the potential of M was used
distractors_en.B: K and M are not on the same surface

question_en: A particle of mass $0.4\ \mathrm{mg}$ hovers between horizontal plates $2\ \mathrm{cm}$ apart with a voltage of $400\ \mathrm{V}$. Find the charge of the particle ($\mathrm{C}$). $g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
question_uz: Orasidagi masofa $2\ \mathrm{cm}$, kuchlanishi $400\ \mathrm{V}$ bo'lgan gorizontal plastinkalar orasida massasi $0.4\ \mathrm{mg}$ bo'lgan zarra muallaq turibdi. Zarra zaryadini toping ($\mathrm{C}$). $g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
question_ru: Между горизонтальными пластинами, расстояние между которыми $2\ \mathrm{cm}$, а напряжение $400\ \mathrm{V}$, висит частица массой $0.4\ \mathrm{mg}$. Найдите заряд частицы ($\mathrm{C}$). $g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. E = U/d = 2·10⁴ V/m, q = mg/E = 4·10⁻⁶/(2·10⁴) = 2·10⁻¹⁰ C.
Asos: qU/d = mg.

distractors_en.A: cm were not converted to metres
